The T35 differential protection devices are designed for the fast and 
 selective short circuit protection of transformers, motors and generators and 
 of other two, three or four phase winding arrangement.

This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
 operation and calibration of the relay. It is recommended this procedure be 
 carried out on an annually bases. The document is formatted the way to 
 minimize the possibility of error causing personal 
 injury or damage to equipment.

The first is initiated by eng. Ahmed Hassan, tested by eng. Sidhom Nassef, 
revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, accepted by eng. Aly Zahran: 
 general manager & eng. Samir Abdel-Gil;il MDEPC quality control general 
 director, approved by eng. Ahmad Sawan: head sector of Nubaria 
power station, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.

ISA DRTS tester
Test leads.
PC laptop with necessary software {ISAWIZARD and ENER VISTA}
Tools bag

sections.text:
Reading the Setting from the 
Relay using the PC

items: Connect the personal computer to the relay
Run the enervista program.
Read the setting and safe it as URGENT FILE FOR T35 [name the feeder].
Connect the personal computer to the ISA tester
Be sure that ISA tester is connected to EARTH.
Switch ON ISA tester.

After ISA tester completely in service connect Currents, Voltages and binary 
 input leads between ISA tester and test plug for T35.

RUN ISAWIZARD software>>>>>GENERATION &DISTRIBUTION RELAYS>>>> Xpro 
 advanced>>>>MANUAL MODE
 NOW you can test the relay.

Insert the test plug in the terminal block BP6 see figure 
 (1)
 NOTE: Do not forget to GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=0V].
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay

Choose Shoot with current value equal to 1.05 of pick up current to get pickup 
 time of the relay.

To test 2nd stage of differential, disable 1st stage of differential then 
 shoot by setting current.
Repeat steps from A-1 with frequency 100Hz for 2nd harmonic test
Repeat steps from A-1 with frequency 250Hz for 5th harmonic test.
Choose STORE ALL TESTS >>>>

Go to RESULTS from main menu chose HEADER and apply all information about 
 these FEEDER and OK
Now print the results and you have complete test results for these relay.

Repeat tests from step 7 to 14 for other test plug (BP7,8,9 and 10 ) see 
 figure 1

Now you have complete test results for these 
 relay

sections.text:
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service

items: Enable any function which was disabled.

Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminals 
 and the test set.
Make sure CT and V T secondary circuits are in normal condition.
Remove the disturbance alarm LED`s on the relay which is caused by the test.
Request feeder to be returned in service.

Take pharos readings of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to 
 those for normal load condition.

Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW, MVAR, Amperes and 
 power factor).
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.

text:
Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The T35 differential protection devices are designed for the fast and 
 selective short circuit protection of transformers, motors and generators and 
 of other two, three or four phase winding arrangement.
This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
 operation and calibration of the relay. It is recommended this procedure be 
 carried out on an annually bases. The document is formatted the way to 
 minimize the possibility of error causing personal 
 injury or damage to equipment.
The first is initiated by eng. Ahmed Hassan, tested by eng. Sidhom Nassef, 
revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, accepted by eng. Aly Zahran: 
 general manager & eng. Samir Abdel-Gil;il MDEPC quality control general 
 director, approved by eng. Ahmad Sawan: head sector of Nubaria 
power station, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Line isolation is required.
Make sure that CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current 
 circuits for test distance protection.
Transmission Line must be grounded.
Tools and Equipment
ISA DRTS tester
Test leads.
PC laptop with necessary software {ISAWIZARD and ENER VISTA}
Tools bag
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolate the relay current circuits for test.
Be sure that the DC power of the relay is correct by applying DC voltmeter 
 across points (B5a,B6a) see figure (1) on the rear of the relay.
Reading the Setting from the 
Relay using the PC
Connect the personal computer to the relay
Run the enervista program.
Read the setting and safe it as URGENT FILE FOR T35 [name the feeder].
For Auxiliary Transformer
Differential Protection Test
Connect the personal computer to the ISA tester
Be sure that ISA tester is connected to EARTH.
Switch ON ISA tester.
After ISA tester completely in service connect Currents, Voltages and binary 
 input leads between ISA tester and test plug for T35.
RUN ISAWIZARD software>>>>>GENERATION &DISTRIBUTION RELAYS>>>> Xpro 
 advanced>>>>MANUAL MODE
 NOW you can test the relay.
Insert the test plug in the terminal block BP6 see figure 
 (1)
 NOTE: Do not forget to GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=0V].
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay
Choose Shoot with current value equal to 1.05 of pick up current to get pickup 
 time of the relay.
To test 2nd stage of differential, disable 1st stage of differential then 
 shoot by setting current.
2nd and 5th Harmonic 
Restraining Test
Repeat steps from A-1 with frequency 100Hz for 2nd harmonic test
Repeat steps from A-1 with frequency 250Hz for 5th harmonic test.
Choose STORE ALL TESTS >>>>
Go to RESULTS from main menu chose HEADER and apply all information about 
 these FEEDER and OK
Now print the results and you have complete test results for these relay.
Repeat tests from step 7 to 14 for other test plug (BP7,8,9 and 10 ) see 
 figure 1
Now you have complete test results for these 
 relay
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service
Enable any function which was disabled.
Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminals 
 and the test set.
Make sure CT and V T secondary circuits are in normal condition.
Remove the disturbance alarm LED`s on the relay which is caused by the test.
Request feeder to be returned in service.
Take pharos readings of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to 
 those for normal load condition.
Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW, MVAR, Amperes and 
 power factor).
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
